import type { CardViewModel, ListingSummary } from '~/types/catalog'
import { listingTitle } from '~/utils/listingTitle'

export function useCatalogHelpers() {
  const { apiUrl } = useRuntimeConfig().public

  function resolveImage(path: string | null): string {
    if (!path) return '/images/placeholder.jpg'
    return path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${apiUrl}${path}`
  }

  function formatCurrency(value: number | null): string {
    if (value == null) return '-'
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(value)
  }

  function getChannelLabel(channel: number): string {
    switch (channel) {
      case 1: return 'Rent'
      case 2: return 'Sale'
      case 3: return 'Rent or sale'
      default: return ''
    }
  }

  function formatArea(value: number): string {
    return `${new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value)} sq ft`
  }

  function mapToCard(listing: ListingSummary): CardViewModel {
    const tags: string[] = []
    if (listing.area) tags.push(formatArea(listing.area))
    if (listing.featured) tags.push('featured')

    return {
      id: listing.id,
      image: resolveImage(listing.imagePath),
      title: listingTitle(listing),
      price: formatCurrency(listing.price),
      location: [listing.district, listing.city].filter(Boolean).join(', '),
      href: `/listing/${listing.slug}`,
      tags,
    }
  }

  return {
    resolveImage,
    formatCurrency,
    getChannelLabel,
    mapToCard,
  }
}
